title: blocks.csv row
description: One row of blocks.csv, after the validator parses the cells: empty cells become null and numbers become integers. Ties a segment to a real address range, for the heading in the curb detail panel.

block_number.description: The hundred, such as 1200 for the 1200 block. Empty when not known.

low_address.description: Smallest house number found on the block.

high_address.description: Largest house number found on the block.

source.description: osm: written by the extraction script. manual: typed by hand and never overwritten by the script.
